0022600240.text: Boston enters this home game at 9-2 after 11 games, first in the Atlantic and first in the East, with a four-game winning streak, a 9-1 mark over its last ten, and a perfect 5-0 record at home. Dallas is 7-4, ninth in the West and 4th in the Southwest, 2 games back, on a three-game winning streak, and the Mavericks will be without Dereck Lively II (foot, surgery), Sergio de Larrea (knee, strain) and Tarik Biberovic (heel, inflammation). Paul George is out for Boston with an illness after averaging 22.0 points in 30.1 minutes per game this season, and the teams have not played each other yet in 2026-27, though the Celtics won both meetings in 2025-26, most recently 120-100 in Boston on March 6, 2026.
